beats.headline: Five boxes meant for Donut
beats.text: Five hours before the Butcher's Masquerade, Carl and Mordecai stand over a table of five items, all from the Apothecary in sponsorship boxes given to different crawlers, all with notes saying they should be given to Donut. Mordecai has never seen anything like it. One is a recharge wand scroll. That one Carl understands, he says, and the tiara and the sheet music too. What he cannot work out is the stick, or the ball peen hammer he picks up next.

beats.headline: Readable from the stage
beats.text: Carl's planning notes for the castle set out how the stage works. When Donut stands on the stage in ballroom A, she can physically handle the items moved to the stage of the attendant ballroom a few stories below: a wand there can be picked up and cast while it stays three floors down. She will be able to read the wand-recharge scroll and her sheet music if she needs them. The one thing she cannot do is drink something that is not with her, so the charm potion has to be smuggled in.

beats.headline: Big Tina's wand glows
beats.text: Donut's song has charmed the room, and Britney has started a faster, baroque piece with the spotlight on Big Tina at the centre of the stage, her pink boa round her neck and her inert wand in her hand. As everyone watches, the wand glows: Donut has just cast the recharge scroll on it. The dinosaur looks at it with wonder and waves it, and sparkles dance through the air. It casts a charm as well, a performer's trick called The Recital, which makes everyone happy to be there and wanting to watch the stage.

beats.headline: A second one, from Orren
beats.text: Carl's inventory is back on, and he has made the exchange with Orren without even looking into the bin. For the homeless man's dirty clothes and a few Valtay items he receives a single wand recharge scroll, three scrolls called Cracker Jack, and Orren's agreement to let them keep the four cretins for the ninth floor. Carl tries to get the Gate of the Feral Gods back as well. Orren refuses and will not budge.
